items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The shared infrastructure layer containing core entity definitions and I/O helpers that block all subsequent user story implementation.
The high-level functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential alphanumeric token assigned to each entry to enable unique targeting for updates or removals.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage in the home directory and for scriptable output.
The minimum viable product consisting of the ability to create and mark entries as finished.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of mandatory design documents including data models and command contracts required before coding.
The primary documentation file detailing usage instructions and storage behavior.
The initial phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration in the project metadata file.
The specific implementation unit responsible for providing a clear message when the collection is empty.
The verification suite divided into unit and integration directories to validate system behavior.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation field during entity instantiation.
The operational command that purges all entries marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operational command that retrieves and displays all entries in either human-readable or machine-parseable format.
A high-priority constraint indicating that no feature work can proceed until the current phase is fully validated.
